description: Source code for wpa_supplicant ucode integration, managing interfaces, BSS data, and events via a custom VM and registry.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_iface_get_uval
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ucode value for a wpa_supplicant interface.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_update_interfaces
methods.description: Updates the registry of interfaces in the ucode VM.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_bss_get_uval
methods.description: Creates a ucode object representing a wpa_bss structure.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_add_bss
methods.description: Adds a BSS to the ucode registry.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_free_bss
methods.description: Removes a BSS from the registry.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_bss_allowed
methods.description: Checks if a BSS is allowed via ucode call.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_update_state
methods.description: Updates the state of a wpa_supplicant interface in ucode.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_event
methods.description: Handles events for wpa_supplicant and updates ucode registry.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_ctrl_event
methods.description: Sends control events to ucode.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_wps_complete
methods.description: Handles WPS credential completion in ucode.

methods.name: obj_stringval
methods.description: Retrieves string value from a ucode object.

methods.name: uc_wpas_add_iface
methods.description: Adds a new interface to wpa_supplicant via ucode.

methods.name: uc_wpas_remove_iface
methods.description: Removes an interface from wpa_supplicant via ucode.

methods.name: uc_wpas_iface_status_bss
methods.description: Adds BSS info to interface status object.

methods.name: uc_wpas_iface_status_multi_ap
methods.description: Adds multi-AP info to interface status object.

methods.name: uc_wpas_iface_status
methods.description: Generates interface status object.

methods.name: uc_wpas_iface_ctrl
methods.description: Sends control commands to interface via ucode.

methods.name: uc_wpas_iface_config
methods.description: Gets or sets interface configuration via ucode.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_init
methods.description: Initializes ucode support for wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_free
methods.description: Frees ucode resources for wpa_supplicant.
